name: Beetroot Pasta
subtitle: Adapted from Nadia Hussein
notes: You may only need half this sauce—it freezes well.

items: 1 large red chili (or some red chili flakes)
14 oz cooked pasta (or zoodles, or cooked sliced cabbage)

steps.title: Make the sauce
steps.body: In a blender, combine **2 cans cooked beets, drained**, **¼ cup olive oil**, **1 Tbsp lemon juice**, **1 tsp salt**, **4 garlic cloves** and **1 large red chili** (or some red chili flakes).

steps.title: Toss with pasta
steps.body: Toss with **14 oz cooked pasta** (or zoodles, or cooked sliced cabbage).

steps.title: Top
steps.body: Top with **7 oz feta cheese** and finely chopped fresh dill.
